canonicalStorage: Recorded PBDB ancestry below the previously documented Crocodylomorpha path; no internal taxon ID or COL equivalence minted. Existing index and other record types preserved.
sourceInterpretation: eag/lag are occurrence-age brackets; selected outer envelope does not establish FAD/LAD, origin/extinction or continuous occupancy. Collection environment and preservation modes are collection-level fields, not whole-species ecological or specimen claims.
readerVisibleDelivery: Canonical prose prepared. PBDB atlas/profile/navigation compatibility mapping, generation, runtime delivery and publication pending content-phase handoff.
projectionMapping: Do not inject PBDB OIDs into COL catalogue profile descriptors. Convert/append the current catalogue-profile text pointers to PBDB atlas-profile using recorded external OIDs at content handoff, preserving existing atlas records and scientific uncertainties.

editorialPass.scope: Only current P5-45 paragraph markers and new neutral limitation headings. Source rows, percentages, ages, names, citations and maturity states retained.

groupAggregateScopeClarification.scope: Group totals cover all authored members, rather than only the named reading examples.
